animation.which_clips: REAL decoded Tekken 3 bank clips (wh-anim/1 JSON from game/assets/anim/t3/king_on_pantera_leoman/ on main): t3_light.json (slot 0xd06, move row 35) plays on PANTERA as his attack; t3_stance.json (slot 0x0, 75f) and t3_walk_fwd.json (slot 0x15, 10f) play on STAR as Idle/Walk (she has no embedded clips). Pantera's Idle/Walk come from the GLB's own embedded animations. t3_light is a crouch-leap strike (root_t Y: 0.952 -> dip 0.803 -> peak 1.334 @ f8-9 -> land 0.956), not a standing jab.
animation.retarget_method: scripts/bank_clip_loader.gd — world-delta FK retarget, NOT a BoneMap and NOT verbatim Animation sharing (both rejected with evidence: verbatim sharing left Star lying flat on the floor — stored locals are absolute poses in the source rig's bone frames). Formula per bone: posed_local = rest_local * (rest_world^-1 * (D * rest_world)), D = source world rotation delta. Canonical->target map: Chest->Spine2 when the target has Spine2 and no Chest; Root skipped (its motion is root_t, applied as Hips position delta on attack clips only); Spine1 driven by slerp(D Spine, D Chest, 0.5). Space conversion is per-rig and auto-detected from the rest pose (detect_conv): Pantera Z-up skeleton space -> rotX+90 conjugation; Star Y-up facing -Z -> rotY180 conjugation (ZMIRROR was probe-rejected — guard went overhead at hand-height 1.92 vs canonical 0.88; rotY180 lands hands at 0.97-1.31 guard height). Quaternion sign continuity enforced per track (a flipped key tumbled the body mid-clip before the fix). Looping stance/walk clips skip hip translation (web-runtime parity; stance root track contains a get-up crouch, root_t Y 0.479->0.982).

phase2_slice.sim_core: sim/fight_sim.gd — class FightSim (RefCounted): no Node, no engine physics, no wall clock, no RNG. Fixed 60 Hz ticks, integer input bitmask (IN_LEFT=1, IN_RIGHT=2, IN_ATTACK=4), press-edge attack detection, WALK_SPEED 1.7 m/s, WALK_BACK 1.3, ATTACK_TICKS 52 (= t3_light 26 frames @30fps), ATTACK_LUNGE 0.55 m/s, PUSH_DISTANCE 0.85, arena clamp +/-4.4, facing auto-update, pushbox separation, state_name() for the view. scripts/fighter_view.gd + scripts/main.gd are presentation only (instantiate GLB, drive AnimationPlayer, mirror sim state; facing via Y-rotation, never negative scale).
phase2_slice.touch_controls: On-screen ◀ ▶ ATK buttons (118x80) in scripts/main.gd set/clear the same sim input bits on button_down/button_up; keyboard A/D/arrows + J feed the identical bits. The deterministic proof run drives the fighters through those same bits (scripted timeline), so the viewed frames exercise the touch path's exact route into the sim.

gaps_to_playable: On-device validation: install the APK on a real mid-range Android phone, confirm Vulkan/Mobile renderer path, frame rate, and touch buttons under real fingers (all proof so far is headless on the Compatibility fallback).

Combat depth: the sim has movement + one attack; no hit/hurtboxes, damage, blocking, throws, rounds, timer, KO, or AI opponent yet (lab/game's Godot 4.3 slice already has rounds/HP/AI patterns to port).

Clip coverage: only 3 bank clips wired (light/stance/walk_fwd for one bank). Roster-wide porting = run BankClipLoader's solver per fighter bank; foreign-skeleton models (109-328 joints: Dio, Doc Frank, Phantom...) are NOT HOUSE-49 and need their own canonical->target maps + rest-space detection validation per rig.
Star's textures: star-house49.glb is textureless (0 images) as shipped on main; her textured attire must be found/embedded by the MINI wire-up lane before she can be shown textured.
Facing/lean polish: Star's retargeted stance reads side-on; per-fighter view yaw and stance phase offsets need an art pass against the original-comparison gate.
Game shell: no menus, character select, stage select, Creation Suite, audio, or settings — the web game's T8-pattern shell specs are the porting source.
Bank clip semantics: t3_stance's root track contains a get-up crouch; if stance root motion is ever enabled, trim the rise-in frames first.

Determinism hardening: the sim is deterministic by construction (fixed tick, no RNG/physics), but rollback/netplay and replay verification are unbuilt; keep the sim/presentation split inviolate as features land.
